correctness.rationale: For every parameter pair the proof replaces a farther endpoint to give an equal-or-longer chord; the stationarity function H has at most one interior maximum. A positive-coefficient power-series comparison yields a unique strict diameter switch, and a Hessian expansion with positive endpoint slope and interior curvature gives the exact 3/2 tail. Endpoint-pair triangular integration yields the exponent 2. The window follows from a nonzero branch-slope gap; all equations and conditioning use the arclength density cosh(x)/(2sinh L). checker.py numerically confirms the contact and local constants but is not used to prove infinity-wide statements.
